annotations.title: Which tariff actions touch this product, and what dates are coming?

description: Currently switched off: it answers "not available" and charges nothing. Use when the user is timing a sourcing, pricing or comment decision around US tariffs: "is anything new on Section 301 for Vietnam?", "when do the chip tariffs take effect?", "can we still comment on the excess-capacity investigation?". Returns recent tariff actions from USTR, Commerce (ITA and BIS), CBP and presidential proclamations that mention the phrase, what is open for comment and for how long, and what takes effect next, each with its Federal Register document number. Refuses before you are charged if its controls show the search or the agency filter is not working. Every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. Calling this tool returns a quote, not the result: what the run measures, its price and a payment_url. The run happens only when you POST to payment_url, and a run that fails its controls refuses there with nothing charged. For the duty actually paid on a product since those actions, use run_effective_duty.

agency.description: Optional: one agency only (ustr, ita, bis, cbp, president).

phrase.description: A product, an HTS heading (e.g. "8542"), a country, or an action such as "Section 301".

since_days.description: How far back to list recent actions, in days. Default 180.

name: run_tariff_clock

available.description: false when the run is switched off; then nothing can be charged.

error.description: Why the inputs were refused, with the expected usage. Nothing is charged.
